content.text:
The server verifies the Turnstile token in `verifyTurnstileToken()` in `src/auth/captcha.ts:24`. It posts the token to Cloudflare's `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify` endpoint (URL constant at `src/auth/captcha.ts:12`).

It is called from two places in `src/server/api-v2.ts`:
- Line 372: `verifyTurnstileToken(body.captchaToken, getClientIp(req))`
- Line 501: the same call.

Both pass the client IP along with the token. I didn't open those two handlers, so I haven't checked which routes they belong to.

The secret comes from `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`, and `.env.example` also has a `TURNSTILE_NON_BLOCKING` flag. I didn't read `captcha.ts`, so I don't know how the secret key or that flag are used.

The `mcp__fullstack-audit__fullstack_find` atlas tool was denied permission, so I used Grep instead.
